title: Stock & Purchasing Coordinator
description:
Stock & Purchasing Coordinator / Operations Assistanrt
West Leeds - Hybrid working available after probation
30,000 - 35,000 Permanent Monday - Friday, 8.30am - 5pm

A well-established and growing business is looking for a Stock & Purchasing Coordinator to join its Operations team.

This is a varied role combining stock administration, purchasing, supplier management, order processing and logistics coordination. You'll be responsible for keeping stock information accurate, monitoring orders and deliveries, resolving queries and working closely with internal teams and external suppliers.

The role would suit an experienced administrator who enjoys working with systems, stock, orders and suppliers and is looking for a long-term opportunity within a friendly and established business.

What's on offer?
- 30,000 - 35,000 salary
- Permanent position
- Monday - Friday, 8.30am - 5pm, 37.5 hours per week
- Hybrid working available after probation, with the opportunity to work from home 1-2 days per week
- Annual bonus scheme
- 25 days' holiday, increasing with length of service
- Option to purchase additional annual leave
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free office parking
- Enhanced sick pay
- Life assurance
- Smart casual dress code

The Role

Working as part of the Operations team, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating incoming stock and monitoring expected delivery dates
- Updating internal systems with stock and supplier information
- Checking supplier pricing and investigating discrepancies
- Raising and processing purchase and stock orders
- Monitoring outstanding orders and deliveries
- Liaising with suppliers to ensure orders are delivered as expected
- Coordinating the movement and processing of stock where required
- Assisting with regular stock checks and system reconciliations
- Investigating and resolving stock, order and invoice queries
- Monitoring customer and supplier orders through to completion
- Supporting internal processes relating to product information and certification
- Working with internal teams to improve systems and processes
- Providing information and updates to colleagues across the business
- Working closely with the sales team to ensure excellent customer service
- Providing general administrative support to the Operations function

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, commercially aware and comfortable working with stock, orders, suppliers and computer systems.

You will ideally have:

Previous experience in an administrative, stock, purchasing, logistics, supply chain or order processing role
Experience working with a stock, purchasing, inventory or ERP system
Good understanding of administrative and order management processes
Strong attention to detail and good numerical skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Confident telephone manner
Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel
Strong organisational and time management skills
Ability to work accurately in a busy environment
Good problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate and resolve issues
Ability to work independently and use your own initiative
A positive, flexible approach and the ability to work well as part of a team
Experience within a technical, manufacturing, construction, distribution or supply-chain environment would be advantageous, although this is not essential.

Travel

The role is primarily office based in West Leeds.

There will be occasional travel to other UK locations for stock checks, approximately 6 times per year. These visits will generally involve 1-2 overnight stays, with accommodation and business expenses paid by the company.

A full UK driving licence is preferred.

Working Pattern

Monday - Friday, 8.30am - 5pm, with a one-hour lunch break.

The position is initially office based, with 1-2 days' home working available following successful completion of probation, subject to line manager approval.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator looking to develop their career within stock, purchasing, logistics or operations with an established and supportive employer.

Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we are only able to respond to candidates who are shortlisted. If you haven't received a response within 48 hours, please assume you have been unsuccessful.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Red Recruitment is recruiting Customer Service Advisors in Leeds city centre to join our client, an award-winning customer management company that has achieved GOLD awards from both Investors in People and Investors in Customers.

In this role, you will provide telephone support to enforcement agents attending customers properties in relation to outstanding utility debt. You will complete structured fact-finding checks, review account information and ensure the correct legal, regulatory and operational procedures have been followed before any action is taken.

You will help ensure every case is handled fairly, accurately and with appropriate consideration for the customer s individual circumstances.

Benefits and Package for a Customer Service Advisor:
- Salary: £26,227.50 per annum
- Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, working hours between 8am and 6pm
- Contract Type: Permanent
- Location: Leeds city centre
- Free parking
- Health and wellbeing programme
- Monthly bonus scheme
- Internal recognition schemes with financial awards
- 33 days annual leave, including bank holidays and your birthday
- Social events, including Summer and Christmas parties
- Full support and training provided
- Career progression opportunities

Key Responsibilities of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Provide telephone and operational support to enforcement agents attending customers properties
- Complete a structured fact-finding process with agents during live property visits
- Review customer accounts, outstanding debt information and previous actions taken
- Check that the relevant legal, regulatory and company procedures have been followed correctly
- Confirm that all required notices, documentation and warrant-related checks have been completed
- Identify factors that could affect how a case should proceed, including vulnerability, affordability concerns or a change of occupier
- Provide guidance to field agents on the appropriate next steps in line with company procedures
- Stop or escalate cases where information is incomplete, procedures have not been followed or additional support is required
- Monitor live cases and provide operational support to help visits progress safely and appropriately
- Escalate complex, sensitive or high-risk cases to specialist teams when required

Key Skills and Experience of a Customer Service Advisor:
- Previous experience in customer service, contact centre, operations support, collections or a regulated environment
- Experience supporting vulnerable customers or handling sensitive situations would be advantageous
- Strong questioning and fact-finding skills, with the confidence to obtain accurate information
- Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to provide clear guidance over the telephone
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow structured procedures accurately
- Good judgement, with the confidence to challenge, stop or escalate a case when necessary
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
- Experience within utilities, debt recovery, revenue protection, financial services or another regulated sector would be beneficial

If you are interested in this position and have the relevant skills and experience required, please apply now!

title: HR Assistant
description:
Sewell Wallis is delighted to be working with a leading global professional services organisation in Leeds, West Yorkshire, that is looking to recruit an HR Assistant to join their busy and collaborative HR team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator or HR Assistant looking for their next step within a well-established, forward-thinking business. You'll be joining a fast-paced team where you'll gain exposure to a wide variety of HR processes and have the opportunity to develop your skills and career.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied HR role supporting the full employee life-cycle, with a particular focus on HR administration and ensuring processes are completed accurately and within deadlines.

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing the full on-boarding process for new starters, including right to work checks, issuing offers and contracts, completing on-boarding activities and setting up employee records.
- Managing the off-boarding process for leavers and ensuring everything is completed within payroll deadlines.
- Processing changes to terms and conditions, including preparing letters and communicating changes to employees.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee information on the HR system.
- Processing changes such as cost centre moves, reporting line changes and contractual amendments.
- Responding to day-to-day HR queries, including maternity, paternity and flexible working.
- Supporting the wider HR team with projects and process improvement initiatives.
- Providing general HR team support, including preparing PowerPoint presentations, taking meeting notes and assisting with day-to-day activities.
- Ensuring all HR administration is completed accurately, efficiently and confidentially.

What skills are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who has previous experience working within an HR Administrator or HR Assistant role and is keen to continue developing their career within HR.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within HR administration or HR support.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- An understanding of UK Right to Work requirements.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume workload.
- The confidence to work independently and take ownership of your workload.
- Experience using HR systems - Workday experience would be advantageous.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A proactive, adaptable and positive approach.
- The ability to work well as part of a busy and collaborative team.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Thrive on variety, systems and solving problems? Build broad HR experience in a lively consultancy where no two clients or working days are the same.

HR Administrator

Wetherby, LS22 5 DZ

£26,000 to £30,000, depending on experience

Full time, permanent

9am to 5pm

Hybrid working from week one, with Mondays and Fridays normally working from home

Some HR Administrator roles involve supporting one company, using one system and following one familiar set of processes.

This is not one of those roles.

At HR180, we are more than an outsourced HR provider. We work as a genuine partner to our clients, which means understanding how each business works and adapting our support accordingly.

An offer letter for one client might be sent through Adobe Sign. Another may need to be checked by a manager first. For another client, it could be uploaded and issued through their own HR system.

The task may sound familiar, but the process behind it often will not be.

For the right person, that is exactly what makes this role so rewarding. You will gain broad, practical HR experience, work alongside experienced HR professionals and learn how different organisations manage every stage of the employee journey.

What You Will Be Doing

You will provide essential administrative support to our HR Advisors and Partners, helping them deliver a responsive and professional service to our clients.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing contracts, offer letters and new starter documents
- Managing leavers, probation reviews, references and right to work checks
- Organising hearings, meetings and interviews
- Taking accurate notes and preparing follow up correspondence
- Supporting disciplinary, grievance, maternity, absence and other employee relations processes
- Maintaining accurate records across several client HR systems
- Monitoring tasks, deadlines and outstanding actions
- Assisting with payroll preparation and reporting
- Supporting the onboarding of new clients
- Helping to organise training sessions and materials
- Contributing to projects and process improvements
- Supporting our monthly networking event and wider office activities

You may move between several clients, systems and priorities during the same day, so keeping track of the detail is essential.

What Makes This Role Different?

The complexity does not come from one individual task. It comes from knowing how that task should be completed for each client.

You will need to learn different systems, templates, approval processes and service expectations. You will also need to understand which actions you can complete independently, when something needs checking and how to prioritise when several clients need support at once.

You will not be expected to know everything on your first day.

We are a team where people do not wait to be told, everyone takes responsibility and everyone has a voice. You will have plenty of support while you learn, but as your confidence grows, we will trust you to think, take ownership and get things moving.

The Person We Are Looking For

You will probably enjoy this role if you:
- Like variety and are energised by a busy working day
- Learn new systems and processes confidently
- Can switch between tasks without losing important details
- Enjoy solving problems rather than waiting for every step to be explained
- Take ownership and follow things through properly
- Can prioritise calmly when several things need attention
- Communicate professionally and confidently
- Know when to act independently and when to ask for guidance
- Care about accuracy and confidentiality
- Bring personality, resilience and a good sense of humour. HR180 even lists gallows humour as one of its six things to know about the team!

Previous HR experience would be useful, but it is not essential.

You may also have developed the right skills within recruitment, payroll, legal services, financial services, accountancy, consultancy, client support, executive assistance or another complex administration environment.

Your ability to learn, adapt, organise and take responsibility is more important than having completed every HR task before.

Why Join HR180?

We are a friendly, down to earth and ambitious HR consultancy with a big mission: to be an example of how a workplace can feel and act.

We work as genuine partners to our clients and we have built a culture where people take responsibility, contribute ideas and do not wait to be told what to do.

You can expect:

£26,000 to £30,000, depending on experience

9am to 5pm working hours

Hybrid working from week one, with Mondays and Fridays normally working from home

23 days holiday, increasing with length of service

Workplace pension with The People s Pension

Free parking at our Wetherby office

Hands on training and support from experienced HR professionals

Broad exposure to different clients, industries and HR situations

Genuine opportunities for internal progression

Regular team socials, from quiz nights and takeaways to pizza making

Monthly team breakfasts

Regular visits from the office dogs

Opportunities to get involved in charity fundraising

A workplace where personality, ideas and a good sense of humour are very welcome

HR180 has a strong history of developing people internally and looks within the team for progression opportunities before recruiting externally.

This opportunity will particularly suit someone who enjoys variety, learns quickly and feels comfortable taking ownership once trained. It is less likely to suit someone looking for one predictable routine or a slower paced administration role.

If you enjoy responsibility and the satisfaction of keeping complex work beautifully organised, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now

Please note: We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role and applications from recruitment agencies will not be considered.

Other suitable experience may include HR Administrator, HR Assistant, HR Support Administrator, People Administrator, HR Coordinator, Recruitment Administrator, Payroll Administrator, Client Services Administrator or Operations Administrator.
